name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
summary: An isolation exercise for the side delts that builds shoulder width.
setup: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Slightly bend your elbows and lean very slightly forward.
Pull shoulders back and down and brace the core.
execution: Raise the arms out to the sides in a slight arc until about shoulder height.
Lead with the elbows rather than the hands.
Pause briefly, then lower under control.
mistakes: Swinging the torso to lift: use a lighter weight and stay still.
Shrugging the traps: keep shoulders down.
Lifting above shoulder height: stop around parallel.
Dropping the weights quickly: control the descent.
